_about: Per-file test-seconds summed from the FULL gate log's parallel reporter lines at 55876826 (2026-10-16); ordering estimates, NOT isolated wall timings. Re-derived by scripts/update-test-weights.mjs from a gate log (chrome-agent-platform-6gk81), replacing the 2026-10-08 isolated measurements that had gone stale (the heaviest file in the suite carried no weight and finished last). Used ONLY to order selected files; never decides which files run (see _provenance, and docs/TEST-COUPLING-INVENTORY.md entry 23). tests/parallel-schedule.test.ts rejects non-parallel, deferred, missing, or read-only-dist names. 2026-10-24 (chrome-agent-platform-ifu81): five files split out of tests/wasm-sync-workspace.test.ts are weighted from IMP-REC's own per-file measurements on this VM (145/145/92/140/124 s) because unweighted they would be treated as light and start late; the parent file drops to 3 s. Re-derive with scripts/update-test-weights.mjs from a gate log when one exists that includes them.

_provenance.measured_host: the fleet VM that produced the source gate log (8 vCPU)
_provenance.measured_method: summed per-test durations from one FULL gate log's `deno test --parallel` reporter lines (scripts/lib/parallel-durations.mjs; step lines excluded so parent totals are not double-counted). Test-seconds under parallel load, not isolated wall seconds: the right RELATIVE input for longest-first ordering, not a per-file time budget.
_provenance.rederivation: node scripts/update-test-weights.mjs <full-gate-log> --tree <sha-of-logged-tree> — the log's own manifest suite_durations carries the same numbers; either source re-derives this table.
_provenance.refreshed_scope: durations recalibrated from the 55876826 FULL log; files under 3s carry no weight and keep their given order
_provenance.guarantee: ordering only: the table may reorder the parallel set but can never add, drop or deselect a file (tests/parallel-schedule.test.ts pins the permutation against the live selection)
_provenance.off_switch: CAP_PARALLEL_SCHEDULE=0 disables this ordering entirely (scripts/run-tests.mjs); documented in docs/CHROME-TEST-CONTRACT.md
